subject.title: fix(logging): warn when configured file writes fail

question: Should blank persisted `logging.file` values become invalid canonical config and require `openclaw doctor --fix` before normal startup?
rationale: The implementation follows repository policy by migrating malformed shipped config through doctor instead of adding a runtime compatibility reader, but accepting the resulting operator-visible upgrade stop is a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept schema plus doctor migration
options.body: Land the tested fail-closed constraint, documented doctor repair, and append-failure warning as the canonical behavior.

options.title: Narrow to write warnings
options.body: Merge only the append-failure diagnostic and defer changing the accepted persisted config contract.

recommendation.title: Accept schema plus doctor migration
recommendation.body: Land the tested fail-closed constraint, documented doctor repair, and append-failure warning as the canonical behavior.
